text_block_list.text:
A sudden rush of wind rustled the leaves 
of the trees. 
Phalaenopsis gazed straight at me... and 
spoke of the future.
choice_data_list: The most beautiful garden...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
If I win prestigious races and elevate the 
club's renown, 
more horsegirls will surely pass through 
these gates.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And here at this club, their running 
talents will undoubtedly bloom. 
In time, it shall become a beautiful 
garden where victories flourish in 
profusion.
choice_data_list:
(...She even plans to forge the club's 
future with her own hands...)

text_block_list.text:
Even as she pushes her body to the brink, 
her eyes are fixed on the distant future. 
Her gaze, both graceful and fearless... is 
truly dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...... 
—Come with me, Trainer. There is a place I 
wish to show you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: We have arrived. ...Lift your head.
choice_data_list: —! What a wonderful view...
—! Such a lovely view...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The sky, the sea, the flowers... Feel how 
quickly your heart finds peace. 
I wanted to share this with you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I, too, often come here. 
Whenever I must face myself anew. Just 
like this—

With that, she sat seiza on the ground. 
Straightening her back with elegance—she 
took a breath.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The adonis heralds the dawn of spring; my 
glory shall flourish in this beautiful 
garden.
choice_data_list: (Is this... a waka poem...?)

text_block_list.text:
...She gracefully captured the scenery 
before our eyes in verse. 
Through her honed focus, I could feel the 
dignified strength of her devotion.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The most beautiful garden. 
A future perhaps too grand for someone as 
frail as me to envision.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet, I have made my choice. 
—I will never cower, nor will I step back.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent vista, overflowing with 
countless blooming victories. 
Only by achieving that can I truly repay 
my debt to this club.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I shall carve out that future myself.
choice_data_list: (She truly has it in her...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Well now, has your spirit cleared? 
The sea is calm now; the breeze should 
feel pleasant.
choice_data_list: ! ...Yeah, thank you.
! ...Yes, thank you.

text_block_list.text:
...Within her heart lies an unshakeable 
conviction. 
A boundless resolve that enables her to 
endure such grueling training.
choice_data_list: (If only I had that kind of resolve...!)
(If only I had that kind of resolve...!)

text_block_list.text:
I want to change how timid I've been about 
deciding the future. 
I want the resolve to courageously forge 
ahead toward tomorrow alongside a 
horsegirl.

And... I want to become a mentor who can 
support the girl standing before me. 
I could never reach those heights as I am 
now... So then—!
choice_data_list:
Phalaeno—there's something I want to ask 
of you.
Phalaeno—I have a favor to ask of you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Very well. Let us hear it.
choice_data_list: I want to become—your apprentice!
I want to become—your apprentice!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
An apprentice? 
...You, a Trainer, to me, an Umamusume of 
this academy?
choice_data_list:
As a Trainer, I want to learn from your 
resolve.

As a Trainer, I want to learn from your 
resolve.

text_block_list.text:
I meet her sharp gaze as her eyes pierce 
straight through me. 
Refusing to shrink before that dignified 
intensity, I look back unflinchingly.
choice_data_list:
The resolve that drives you... to bravely 
face every challenge.

The resolve that drives you... to bravely 
face every challenge.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...... 
—Wait for me in the dojo.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The latest research papers, alongside 
public records on Eastern medicine. 
All of these concern my 
constitution—beginning with my inverted 
body temperature.

Numerous documents sat stacked high upon 
the dojo floor. 
Just as I was about to ask her what she 
planned to start so abruptly—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I shall accept you as my apprentice.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
However, I give you one trial. 
Comprehend my constitution, master it... 
and bring me victory in the Selection 
Race.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Merely learning will not engrave resolve. 
Direct my training—and prove your own 
resolve to me.
choice_data_list: —! ...Yes! I'm ready!

text_block_list.text:
After staying up nearly all night 
devouring the documents she gave me... 
I laid out a training regimen before her 
the following morning.
choice_data_list:
To start... I want to gauge your abilities 
with this.

To start... I want to gauge your abilities 
with this.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Oh? ...Come, let me see.

With that, she skimmed through the regimen 
sheet... 
before picking up a red pen and 
overwriting the number of sets.
choice_data_list:
...Wait, that's more than double the 
workload?!

...Wait, that's more than double the 
workload?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You... have held back on the training 
volume, 
taking my constitution into account, have 
you not?
choice_data_list: —! Well...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Factoring in one's physical condition is 
distinct from discipline. 
If anything, I would not mind increasing 
it further still.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I shall show you. —We are heading out. 
Follow me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
First is interval running, then. 
...Burn what you see firmly into your 
eyes.

Lightly kicking off the turf, she broke 
into a run. 
Without a hitch in form or speed, she 
displayed a remarkably steady stride.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Tepid, just as I thought! 
Hyaaaah!!
choice_data_list: —! What incredible...!

text_block_list.text:
She effortlessly exceeded my expectations. 
Her powerful, propulsive stride gave no 
hint of a frail constitution to any 
observer.
choice_data_list:
(Just how much discipline did it take to 
reach this level...?)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Now you see. 
Half-hearted discipline will never suffice 
for me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Train me with the intent to conquer my 
constitution! 
Without at least that much resolve, you 
are unfit to be my apprentice.
choice_data_list: ...Understood. I'll take that to heart.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...... 
—However, starting with interval runs was 
not a bad decision.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Acceleration, stamina, form—a regimen that 
tests a runner's fundamental skills. 
You sought to thoroughly assess every 
facet of my ability, no doubt.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
From now on, assign your training without 
hesitation. 
I expect tactical leadership that will 
guide me to victory.
choice_data_list: Y-Yes! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.text:
Daring, yet carrying herself with poised 
grace. 
And so began my life as Phalaenopsis's 
apprentice.
